content_sections.heading: MPERC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. MPERC/Secretary/2026/1379 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MPERC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university. Experience: Minimum 20 years of experience in government owned Power Sector/ Utility or PSU for deputation. Minimum 20 years in Power Sector for retired officers/private sector professionals. Age limit: Maximum 55 years (as on 30 September 2026) Desirable: Specialization in Regulatory Law.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MPERC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have a third child born on or after 26-01-2001. Persons convicted by a court of law for an offence involving moral turpitude.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial period of two (02) years, extendable at the discretion of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: CV Latest passport-size photograph Attested copies of all certificates and testimonials ACRs / APARs for the last 5 years NOC and Vigilance Clearance Certificate (for deputation)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPERC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download application format from the MPERC website. Fill the application form completely with required self-attested documents. Submit the application in three (3) sets in hard copies. Send the application to The Commission Secretary, Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission, Metro Plaza, 4th Floor, E-5, Arera Colony, Bittan Market, Bhopal – 462 016. Make sure it reaches by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Director.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MPERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (MPERC website) and send it to The Commission Secretary, Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission, Metro Plaza, 4th Floor, E-5, Arera Colony, Bittan Market, Bhopal – 462 016, by by post or in person, to reach by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years (as on 30 September 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ₹141800-214700 for Deputation and Contract.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university with relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have a third child born on or after 26-01-2001. Persons convicted by a court of law for an offence involving moral turpitude.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial period of two (02) years, extendable at the discretion of the Commission.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bhopal.
